name: Edward A O'Sullivan
bio: Edward A O'Sullivan He is an emerging young Australian actor represented by the Centre Stage Agency.

credits.title: Allen
credits.overview: 20 years after his encounter with an alien, Petey never moved on. Now his old friend has returned, and the reason why is complicated — and unexpected.

credits.title: A Match Made in Melbourne
credits.overview: Georgie, a travel writer, travels to Melbourne for an assignment where she meets Zach, an ex-Australian footballer who agrees to be her tour guide and shows her that there's more to life than work.
